title: Pig King leaves the pen: the party brawler is out in Steam Early Access, AED 17 at launch

sources.note: Steam store page and appdetails (cc=ae): Early Access, 12 Nov 2026, Windows only, AED 17.00 after 17% launch discount (20.49 before), developer TwoPeaks, publisher Isle of Strays; up to 4 players, PvP and co-op; Steam Deck tested by the developer
TwoPeaks Steam announcement 'PIG KING IS OUT NOW IN EARLY ACCESS!': limited 17% early access discount, launch stream 7 PM CET, Dev Bash 27 Nov

first_report: TwoPeaks Steam announcement 12 Nov 2026 about 16:00Z (5 PM CET launch); Famitsu covered it 13 Nov 07:52Z; about 30 h old at the slot, no Arabic coverage found, so it runs as a story the Arabic press has not carried
sensitive: none (cartoon pig brawler; the Steam page lists no content descriptors; zombie pigs and weapons described neutrally as the page does; no gore shown)
footage: official Steam Early Access trailer (appid 4563590, 1080p60, 5.7 Mbps, decode clean), stretches 25.6, 31.96, 36.96 to 40.91, 42.1 to 45.98, 8.98 and 13.05 from the server shot picker; its own sound with the audio split; transcribed 16 kHz VAD: no speech
gate: gate 09:20Z: Steam store page and appdetails (cc=ae) and the TwoPeaks Steam announcement read in full; no Update or Correction on the page; web and Steam news show no denial or change; Famitsu 13 Nov covers it; no Arabic coverage found

angle.hook: a party brawler where you play a pig and the loser comes back as a zombie pig
angle.why_now: Early Access went live on Steam 12 Nov 2026 with a 17 percent launch discount
angle.what_it_means_here: AED 17 on the UAE Steam store, Windows only, no Arabic in the language list
